identity.title: Include Source Quality evidence in Run Records

origin.summary: The owner approved continuing after PL-0019; the master backlog selects L-10 Source Quality evidence in Run Record.

state.current_summary: Source Quality Run Record schema 1.8, exact execution reuse, export and Results parity, fail-closed compatibility, actual EXE layouts, and refreshed R0 inputs are complete and verified.

objective.summary: Include identified Source Quality evidence in current Run Records and expose the same evidence in Runner exports and Shell Results.
constraints: Reuse the existing SourceQualityReport and C3D snapshot already loaded by ordered execution; do not add a second source load or inspection execution.
Require exact source entity, byte, content, unit, and report identity compatibility and fail closed on mismatch.
Preserve legacy Run Record reading with explicit unavailable presentation.
Keep Preview, Publish, Run, Validation, recipe identity, and acceptance decisions unchanged.
Verify current Wide and Compact Results layouts and refresh the fixed R0 package after binary changes.

criteria.text: Schema 1.8 records one identified Source Quality snapshot whose report identity exactly matches the Run Record source.
Shell and Runner ordered execution project the same existing source-quality report without a second source load or inspection execution.
JSON, HTML, CSV, Runner text, and Shell Results expose consistent quality coverage, grid, mask, frame, unit, provenance, and channel evidence.
Source identity mismatch fails closed and legacy or unavailable reports remain readable and explicitly unavailable.
Focused regression, Release build, actual Wide and Compact EXE review, non-execution checks, and fixed R0 validation all pass with durable evidence.

context.summary: The existing WPF-neutral report owns source, grid, coverage, height, coordinate, provenance, and channel evidence.
The current schema 1.7 root has timing and inspection evidence but no Source Quality snapshot.
Ordered execution already loads the verified C3D snapshot used by both Runner and Shell.
Runner owns JSON, HTML, and CSV output while Shell owns its local text and Results projections.

evidence.observation: Shell ordered Run passed 15/15; schema 1.8 Source Quality validates against the Run Record source and the execution reuses the exact loaded report instance.

Ordered execution loads one C3D snapshot, accepts the already loaded Shell report after exact compatibility checks, and otherwise computes Runner Source Quality from that same snapshot; focused Shell and general Runner checks passed.
Actual Runner text, JSON, HTML, and CSV contained the same invalid-cell-mask SHA-256; final Wide and Compact Results showed the same 4x4, 100.0% valid, 0.0% missing evidence without Compact clipping.

Mismatched supplied Source Quality failed before any ordered step, history passed 12/12 with explicit legacy Unavailable, and artifact-owned A2 compatibility passed 22/22 with explicit Unavailable evidence.

Release built with 0 warnings and 0 errors; focused suites, structure, Wide/Compact screenshot quality and monitor intersection, and both refreshed fixed R0 ValidateOnly modes passed with D-backed evidence.

events.summary: Resolved after exact evidence reuse, parity, negative, Release, actual EXE, and R0 input verification passed.
